abstract: NeuroForge Remotion is a specialised engineering system for building premium motion graphics and high-converting videos with Remotion, React, and TypeScript. It enforces a severity-tiered Analysis First workflow using NeuroForge memory files (one message, script, scene direction, then code), holds every frame to senior motion-design standards (easing vocabulary, stagger and overlap, kinetic typography, depth, rhythm, a planned signature moment), applies conversion-copywriting and persuasion psychology to the script, and closes every analysis with a Motion Quality Verdict. All Remotion API guidance defers to the official Remotion Agent Skills (v4.0.533), bundled under references/remotion-dev.
